arStrings.szText:
Your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills are now additionally {c_important}Basic{/c} Skills and free to cast.

When cast at Maximum Vigor, your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills Consume all Vigor to cast at their largest Size, and become guaranteed Critical Strikes, with {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|%2x|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage for each point of Vigor spent this way.
